configurations.name: portal
configurations.description: React 18 + Vite frontend — Dashboard, Traces, LiveStream, Cost, Agents pages (proxies /api → :8080)

configurations.name: mock-gateway
configurations.description: Python mock API gateway — accepts collector spans, serves all portal endpoints + WebSocket. No Docker needed.

configurations.name: api-gateway
configurations.description: Go Chi REST API + WebSocket hub :8080 — requires infra running first

configurations.name: collector
configurations.description: Go OTLP collector — gRPC :4317, HTTP :4318, Prometheus metrics :9090 — requires api-gateway
runtimeArgs: set AF_GRPC_ADDR=0.0.0.0:4317 && set AF_HTTP_ADDR=0.0.0.0:4318 && set AF_AUTH_REQUIRE_AUTH=false && set AF_JWT_SECRET=dev-secret && set AF_GATEWAY_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8080 && set AF_DEBUG=true && set AF_PII_ENABLED=true && collector-dev.exe

configurations.name: af-core
configurations.description: Rust policy engine + Kafka consumer — gRPC :50051, HTTP :8889 — requires infra running first

configurations.name: full-stack
configurations.description: All 13 services via Docker Compose — Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis, Kafka, collector, af-core, api-gateway, portal, Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger

configurations.name: infra
configurations.description: Infrastructure only — Postgres :5432, ClickHouse :8123/:9000, Redis :6379, Kafka :9092. Start this before running Go/Rust services natively.
runtimeArgs: docker compose up postgres clickhouse redis zookeeper kafka

configurations.name: prometheus
configurations.description: Prometheus metrics scraper — UI at :9090, scrapes collector + api-gateway

configurations.name: grafana
configurations.description: Grafana dashboards — UI at :9091 (container :3000), default admin/admin

configurations.name: jaeger
configurations.description: Jaeger distributed tracing UI — :16686, gRPC collector :14250
